summary: Backend security fix verification complete. All 3 MEDIUM findings (SEC-001 mock endpoint allowlist, SEC-002 .gitignore env paths, SEC-003 server-side premium enforcement on /phases/advance) and P3 hardening (JWT issuer pinning + 30s clock-skew leeway) verified via 12 new tests in /app/backend/tests/test_security_fixes.py. Full suite: 58/58 pass (46 existing regressions + 12 new). No modifications made to existing test files.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1188 lines — could be split into routers/modules (users, entitlement, phases, journal, safety, memory-path) for better maintainability. Not a security concern but flagged per code review guidelines (>700 lines).

SEC-001 impl (server.py:55-65 _is_admin_email) correctly handles both full-email and @domain-suffix entries; empty allowlist disables the endpoint even when ALLOW_MOCK_ENTITLEMENT=1 — good defense-in-depth.
SEC-003 impl (server.py:565-574) uses HTTP 402 Payment Required with structured detail {error, message, target_phase} — mobile clients can key off `error === 'premium_required'`.
P3 impl (server.py:307-322) pins iss to `${SUPABASE_URL}/auth/v1` and enables verify_iss only when SUPABASE_URL is set; leeway=30s is sensible.
seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data. Each SEC-003 test creates + cleans up its own user (subs 22..88). QA fixtures already wipe on session boundary.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Security fixes verified. New test file at /app/backend/tests/test_security_fixes.py contains 8 test classes covering SEC-001/002/003 and P3 issuer+leeway. conftest.make_jwt() now injects iss automatically from SUPABASE_URL. For wrong-issuer testing, mint tokens manually with jose_jwt.encode (see TestP3IssuerPinning.test_wrong_issuer_rejected). ADMIN_EMAILS=@projectlife.local in backend/.env — QA fixture email qa+iter5@projectlife.local is allowlisted.
rca_of_issue:
N/A — verification-only iteration. All fixes work as specified:
- SEC-001: allowlisted @projectlife.local email -> 200; random@notallowed.example -> 404 (user NOT upgraded, verified via subsequent GET /entitlement).
- SEC-002: /app/.gitignore contains exact lines `backend/.env` and `frontend/.env` (lines 90-91).
- SEC-003: free user 0->1 succeeds (200); free user 1->2 returns 402 with detail.error='premium_required' and target_phase=2 (user stays at phase 1); premium user 1->2 succeeds after mock unlock.
- P3 issuer: token with iss=https://evil.supabase.co/auth/v1 rejected with 401 'Invalid token: Invalid issuer'.
- P3 leeway: token with exp 10s in the past + iat 60s ago accepted (200) due to 30s leeway.
